s1.syndrome_frame: Acute metabolic crisis with renal failure in a patient with multiple comorbidities
key_facts: Decreased oral intake and dehydration for at least one week
Received 1 L of intravenous normal saline
Somnolent and oriented only to self
Vital signs: temperature 37.1 °C, blood pressure 101/59 mmHg, heart rate 105 beats per minute, respiratory rate 17 breaths per minute, and oxygen saturation 100% on room air
Sarcopenic-appearing man with dry mucous membranes
Acute renal failure with sodium 145 mEq/L, potassium 6.6 mEq/L, blood urea nitrogen 207 mg/dL, creatinine 10.2 mg/dL
Severe metabolic acidosis with bicarbonate 8 mEq/L, anion gap 31, venous pH 7.09, and lactate 4.4 mmol/L
Home medications included insulin glargine, insulin aspart, and empagliflozin

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute metabolic crisis with renal failure in a patient with multiple comorbidities
key_facts: Decreased oral intake and dehydration for at least one week
Received 1 L of intravenous normal saline
Somnolent and oriented only to self
Vital signs: temperature 37.1 °C, blood pressure 101/59 mmHg, heart rate 105 beats per minute, respiratory rate 17 breaths per minute, and oxygen saturation 100% on room air
Sarcopenic-appearing man with dry mucous membranes
Acute renal failure with sodium 145 mEq/L, potassium 6.6 mEq/L, blood urea nitrogen 207 mg/dL, creatinine 10.2 mg/dL
Severe metabolic acidosis with bicarbonate 8 mEq/L, anion gap 31, venous pH 7.09, and lactate 4.4 mmol/L
Home medications included insulin glargine, insulin aspart, and empagliflozin

differentials: Ketoacidosis due to type 2 diabetes mellitus
per_call: Ketoacidosis due to type 2 diabetes mellitus

shortlist.label: Euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has type 2 diabetes mellitus, severe metabolic acidosis, and elevated β-hydroxybutyrate level

shortlist.label: Lactic acidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has severe metabolic acidosis, elevated lactate level, and acute renal failure

shortlist.label: Uremic acidosis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has acute renal failure with severe metabolic acidosis and elevated anion gap

shortlist.label: Starvation ketosis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has history of decreased oral intake and dehydration for at least one week

shortlist.label: Acute tubular necrosis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has acute renal failure with severe metabolic acidosis and elevated creatinine level

raw.rationale: The patient has a history of type 2 diabetes mellitus, was taking empagliflozin, and presented with severe metabolic acidosis, elevated β-hydroxybutyrate level, and trace ketones on urinalysis, which are all consistent with euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis.

rejected.label: Lactic acidosis
rejected.why: Although the patient has an elevated lactate level, the primary issue is the severe metabolic acidosis with an anion gap and the presence of ketones, which points more towards diabetic ketoacidosis.

rejected.label: Uremic acidosis
rejected.why: While the patient has acute renal failure, the presence of ketones and the specific pattern of metabolic acidosis suggest diabetic ketoacidosis as the primary cause.

rejected.label: Starvation ketosis
rejected.why: Although the patient had decreased oral intake, the severity of the metabolic acidosis and the presence of other diagnostic criteria make euglycemic diabetic ketoacidosis a more likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Acute tubular necrosis
rejected.why: This condition could contribute to the patient's acute renal failure but does not directly explain the metabolic acidosis and ketosis.
